question: Does a CM multiplier factor base turn its relation-count advantage into a significant complete-cold end-to-end improvement over matched coordinate and plain-point bases on held-out targets?

claims.text: Every completed arm recovers and independently verifies the planted scalar.
The multiplier base lowers complete counted cost against the coordinate and equal-point controls on this j=0 curve.
claims.if_supported: a scoped constant-factor counted-cost improvement for this native signed MITM pipeline
claims.if_not_supported: the relation advantage did not lower complete counted cost under this protocol

claims.text: The multiplier base lowers the L2 complete-cold method-call wall interval against the coordinate control beyond A/A noise.
claims.if_supported: a scoped end-to-end wall-time improvement on the pinned host class and toy curve
claims.if_not_supported: no end-to-end wall-time improvement is established

claims.text: No result here establishes an exponent change or rules out a higher-degree extension-field decomposition algorithm.

hypotheses.statement: Known signed CM multiples let the pair table expose many vertices while elimination solves only two seed-log columns, reducing relation and matrix work enough to offset construction and table costs.
hypotheses.mechanism: Every table point has a known coefficient on one seed column; the table vertex count grows without a matching increase in unknown factor-base logarithms.

predictions.minimum_effect: candidate/control point ratio at most 0.75 with the 95% upper bound below 1 against both coordinate-glv and plain-equal-points

provenance.decisive_scope: the 12 targets generated by target_seed 2026110201 and all six measured rounds; no row from these cells was seen during parameter selection

predictions.minimum_effect: candidate/coordinate point ratio at most 0.80 with the 95% upper bound below 1 and candidate A/A containing 1

data_seen.measured: operation-count training only; complete-cold wall is the missing gate

provenance.decisive_scope: the 12 targets generated by target_seed 2026110201 and all six L2 measured rounds; earlier work observed no complete-cold ecbench method-call clock

arms.description: plain seeds at approximately the candidate vertex count
the candidate's two seeds without multiplier closure
two seed columns with signed CM multiplier vertices
an independently scheduled duplicate of the candidate

positive.expected_detection: the frozen detector reports the training-known large reduction from restoring the multiplier closure

negative.not_applicable_reason: this is a paired method-cost comparison on fixed instances, not a population-structure claim

factors.name: targets
factors.how: uniform_scalar_sha256_v1, independent of arm and unseen in training

factors.name: binary
factors.how: binary hash recorded in every row

factors.name: threads
factors.how: one native thread and a whole reserved core

factors.name: algorithm_seed
factors.how: ecbench derives and records a seed per execution from the frozen measurement seed

factors.name: arm_order
factors.how: alternate_measured balances each arm position across six measured rounds

factors.name: host_load
factors.how: L2 isolation, steal, PSI, run queue and foreign busy ticks recorded per row

factors.name: table_vertices
factors.how: coordinate and equal-point controls separate vertex count from column sharing

seed_derivation.note: ecbench derives every target and algorithm seed from the frozen spec and records it

instance_sampling.rule: 12 target scalars from target_seed 2026110201 on the fixed registered curve

blinding.how: the exact ecbench analysis script and thresholds are frozen before data; method identities are structurally obvious from inventories, so label masking would not blind this analyst

power.note: 72 paired cells per arm; a conjunctive gate requires both comparisons to pass, the target effects are at least 25% by rule, and prior training reported order-of-magnitude counted effects

preflight_runtime.measured_on: merged 2026-10-23 four-target operation-count training plus current exact planning; conservative wall estimate, no held-out timing observed

primary.name: S
primary.definition: all charged factor-base, oracle, relation, elimination and verification work divided by sqrt(r)

primary.name: complete counted work
primary.definition: all charged phases of one verified method call

primary.name: complete cold method-call wall
primary.definition: per-call setup through solve, in-child verification and report completion; excludes workload construction and process launch

secondary.name: fork-to-reap wall
secondary.definition: whole child process including workload reconstruction

secondary.name: relation trials and rank work
secondary.definition: relations-phase GAE, targets tried, relations found, matrix rows and rank

measurement.timed_primary_justification: The request is specifically for end-to-end speed; counted GAE remains co-primary, and the complete cold clock is admitted only at L2 against the session's A/A interval.

stopping_rules.rule: fixed design: 6 arms x 12 targets x (1 warmup + 6 measured rounds) = 504 executions, then stop
wrong answers, exhaustion and timeouts remain rows; no parameter, target or threshold changes after inspection

invalidation_rules: a wrong_answer row is excluded from the speed ratio and reported
wall rows below L2 or after a restore are descriptive only; counted work remains
a failed candidate A/A timing gate makes the wall claim inconclusive

decision_rule.text: C-cost requires multiplier/coordinate-glv and multiplier/plain-equal-points S ratios each <=0.75 with 95% upper bounds <1. C-e2e additionally requires multiplier/coordinate-glv method_call_wall ratio <=0.80 with upper bound <1 and the multiplier/multiplier-aa method-call interval containing 1.
decision_rule.threshold: joint conjunctive thresholds stated in text
decision_rule.statistic: ratio of paired sums over workload-round cells
decision_rule.interval: target-clustered paired bootstrap interval of the ratio of sums, resampling targets and rounds within target, 95%; the linearised t interval is reported as a sensitivity check
decision_rule.effect_size_measure: candidate/control ratio and reciprocal speed factor

graphs: paired S and complete-cold wall ratios with 95% intervals

inadmissible: retuning size or norm from held-out rows
calling a relation-stage ratio an end-to-end speedup
claiming coordinate-defined or higher-degree extension-field bases are disproved

literature.claim: generic preprocessing lower bounds constrain this table mechanism; they do not prove an implementation ratio
merged parameter training, not confirmatory evidence
